dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_project_categories: Child rows are accessed only after checking the parent project owner and active organization; generic SQL tools give tables without tenant columns a WHERE 1=0 view. Reviewed against the parent-access DB regressions.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_runs: Child rows are accessed only after checking the parent project owner and active organization; generic SQL tools give tables without tenant columns a WHERE 1=0 view. Reviewed against the parent-access DB regressions.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_cell_outputs: Child rows are accessed only after checking the parent project owner and active organization; generic SQL tools give tables without tenant columns a WHERE 1=0 view. Reviewed against the parent-access DB regressions.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_cell_output_generations: Internal cell output generation rows are accessed only after checking the parent project owner and active organization; generic SQL tools expose no unscoped child rows.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_kernel_operations: Kernel control receipts require the parent namespace principal and organization. Generic SQL tools expose no unscoped child rows.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_notebook_creation_receipts: Creation receipts can contain private draft cells and are read only through the authorized project creation actions.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_cell_outputs: Published result rows are read only after authorizing the parent project and selected version in the active organization, then rechecking current connection access; generic SQL tools expose no unscoped child rows.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_publish_previews: Private preview snapshots require the recording actor and current project edit access.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_publish_preview_cancels: Cancellation receipts are private to the actor under the project.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_project_releases: Immutable release rows require parent project access and role-specific source projection.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_release_manifest_outputs: Release manifest rows are scoped through their parent release. Actions authorize the pinned release and recheck source grants before artifact access.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_sessions: Private app sessions require access to the session principal and pinned release.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_session_receipt: Private session receipts require access to the parent session and release.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_default_caches: Default cache generations require access to the pinned release and its result sources.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_saved_views: Saved view overrides require the recorded principal and access to the pinned release.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_grants: App-only grants require access to the project and workspace member.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_share_receipts: Sharing receipts require the recording actor and current project sharing authority.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_schedules: Schedule definitions require the project and effective schedule authority.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_schedule_recipi: Subscriptions require an authorized schedule and recipient.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_schedule_ticks: Ticks and pinned release state require current project schedule authority.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_schedule_delive: Delivery rows require access to their parent schedule and run.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_published_app_schedule_receip: Schedule receipts require the recording actor and current project schedule authority.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_thread_turns: Ask turns require parent conversation and producing-source access.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_thread_grants: Conversation access grants require current owner or member authority.
dbToolScopingDenylist.analytics2_thread_receipts: Conversation mutation receipts require owner authority.
